sections.heading: Planning your Tengah Garden Residences interior
sections.text:
Tengah is a new town that is still being built out, which has a practical effect on renovation: you may be among the earlier private-housing households in a landscape of new roads, new parks and, over time, new amenities. The interior still has to work on day one. That usually means serious storage — an entry cabinet, a living-room joinery wall, full-height wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry — rather than a temporary arrangement of loose furniture while you “see how the town develops”. Maison designs that work as built-in carpentry, not as flat-pack furniture, and we can present it in a wide room view or in closer studies of a kitchen run, a wardrobe or a headboard wall.

We have no official floor plan on file and will not invent typologies for this estate. District 24 also includes Novo Place in this batch, and Keat Hong Grange is already live in nearby Choa Chu Kang; those are internal links for readers, not a claim that the estates share a layout or a management set of rules. Walking times to any future or existing MRT station are not something we will guess.

When a key date is in writing, plan backwards from it: defects inspection, a measured survey, the management renovation application, then fabrication lead time. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial figure only. If you already have an approved plan, send it to Maison and we can start the design conversation now, well before any on-site work. We are an independent designer and are not affiliated with the developer.
